name: Panda Robot (Youyou)
summary: A humanoid dressed as a giant panda, built on Walker's servo technology and sent to the China Pavilion at Expo 2020 Dubai as a national mascot. Under the fur are 41 servo joints and an omnidirectional perception system; 'Youyou' greets visitors and demonstrates calligraphy and painting.
notable: National mascot robot at the China Pavilion, Expo 2020 Dubai
